brief.goal: Increase available mounting width while preserving edge-relative fastener layout.
brief.requirements: Widen by 40 mm from current width; retain left datum, depth 80 mm, thickness 4 mm, four Ø6 holes with centers 12 mm from their adjacent edges. Keep hole symmetry about the NEW plate center. Protect device/neighbor geometry and placement, >=2 mm device Z separation, >=25 mm neighbor X separation.
brief.assumptions: Evaluator-authored synthetic geometric design intent; reference boxes are not physical electronics or load models.
brief.questions: Loads, material, fasteners and manufacturing tolerances unspecified.
